title: Born in Muskogee, Oklahoma, 1907; parents and siblings
summary: Thomas gives his birth date, the Oklahoma statehood land giveaway, his siblings George and Cleora born in Texas, and his parents' names and origins.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born February the Tenth, 1907. And to put it in the right perspective, I was born a month and teen days after Oklahoma went into statehood.

Muskogee, Oklahoma. And they had a deal before statehood that every child that was born in Oklahoma was given 150 acres of land. They did that to influence people to come and settle in Oklahoma. I'll tell you later about my grandfather, because he came over earlier. And...

I was the first child born in Oklahoma. My other brother and sister, George and Cleora, they were born in Texas. And that had a great effect on my life, as I later analyzed it. I don't know what I was doing, analyzing things that young. But I went to a grade school...
Well, before you go into grade school, Foots, I want to know your father's name and your mother's name.
My father's name was Joseph Thomas. And my mother's name was Magdalen. I'd always known it as Maggie, but it was Magdalen.

Yeah, from Texas. My grandfather, I found out later, was Tennessee or Georgia. My daughter is busy in the archives finding out all about my parents. And I don't know whether my mother was born in Texas. But I know that I always thought they all came from Texas. But I found out they migrated from I think it was Georgia -- because my grandmother was part-Indian, you know.
